nits_non_blocking.description: The diagnostic CSV block is NOT wrapped in try/except, while the two reporter blocks immediately above ARE wrapped with `except Exception as exc: logger.warning(...)`. If the CSV write fails, the exception propagates and `Rule_Set_Selector.run()` raises, even though `self._persist_output(output_dict)` has already been called and the main output is safe on disk.
